title: Aromatic Glazed Peruvian Chicken Ceviche
description: A fresh and snappy one-pot Peruvian dish featuring pomegranate and glaze, served in a ramekin, this recipe is FODMAP-friendly and perfect for a light lunch.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together pomegranate juice, lime juice, olive oil, ginger, garlic-free seasoning, and salt.
Add the chicken to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and place it in a ramekin.
Pour the remaining marinade over the chicken and top with pomegranate seeds and chopped cilantro.
Bake the chicken in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, prepare the glaze by reducing the marinade in a saucepan over medium heat until thickened.
Remove the chicken from the oven and brush the glaze over the top.
Return the chicken to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes or until the glaze is caramelized.
